editorial: You never expected a routine morning to turn into a life‑or‑death scramble. When a cryptic call places a ticking bomb beneath your seat, every turn feels like a race against fate while your children sit in the rear. The film’s relentless pace is amplified by a handheld camera that makes you feel the car’s vibrations and the kids’ fear. Yet the third act’s pacing hiccups dilute some of the original urgency. If you crave heart‑pounding thrills that keep you glued to the screen, this is for you.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
